# juno-adx-client


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

This package wraps the small Azure authentication and query helpers that
were originally sketched in the repo notebook. It keeps the runtime
dependencies explicit and moves connection setup behind functions so
imports stay safe in notebooks and modules.

## Developer Guide

The package source lives in `nbs/00_core.ipynb` and exports into
`juno_adx_client/core.py`.

### Install juno_adx_client in Development mode

``` sh
$ pip install -e .[dev]

# export notebook changes into the package
$ nbdev_export

# run the full nbdev prep pipeline when Quarto is available
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install from the repo in editable mode while developing:

``` sh
$ pip install -e .[dev]
```

Runtime dependencies include:

- azure-identity
- azure-kusto-data
- azure-keyvault-secrets
- pandas

### Documentation

When Quarto is installed, nbdev can build docs from the notebooks and
publish them to [pages](https://equinor.github.io/juno-adx-client/).

## How to use

Create an `ADXClient` from notebook variables and pass an explicit
database plus either a raw KQL query or a table name.

``` python
from juno_adx_client import ADXClient

cluster_url = ...
database_name = ...
query_text = ...

client = ADXClient(cluster_url, interactive_login=True)
client.perform_query(query=query_text, database=database_name)
```
